virals_narrative: Hormozi owned the day with four 'no magic, only the work' one-liners (217k, 93k, 89k, 56k). Codie's hard-number job-market hook ('220M+ Open to Work', 110k) and Sahil Bloom's 'everything matters' (83k) were next. Short, linkless, slightly scolding lines beat everything else; Justin Welsh's boring-basics list (45k) and James Clear's Monday question (37k) show the reflective version also lands. Austin Kleon, Dan Koe, Rick Rubin, Perell, Butcher, Amanda Natividad and Priya Parker were quiet. Outsider niche was thin; the biggest was an AI-made personal brand post (51k views, low likes) and 'AI can't replicate community trust' (2k). Opening for @iprashantpillai: take the 'only the work' energy into the creative-maker lane, and pair 'open to work vs open for business' with selling.
